posts.title: Unity 6.6 Is Here So Toss These Packages in the Trash
posts.description: Unity 6.6 is out, and with it a raft of improvements that make two editor utilities I built obsolete. You can now navigate through your editor selection history — goodbye Selection History Navigator — and the updated hierarchy window now shows component icons like my Hierarchy Icons package once did.

posts.title: Thirteen Photos of Street Art From Puerto Vallarta, Plus a Crocodile
posts.description: Puerto Vallarta, Mexico is a beautiful place. We got stranded for three days when cartel goons started burning cars and the airport shut down, but otherwise it was a great trip. Lots to see and do — beaches and tacos and iguanas — and photo ops galore. Here are a few shots from Zona Romántica and Bucerías to the north.

posts.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
posts.description: After an eternity I finished reading The Count of Monte Cristo. It’s a lengthy tale. It contains everything a novel should: a daring prison escape, secret identities, hidden treasure, duels, revenge, murder, endless gossip among the fashionable elites of Paris.
